registryEvidence.custodian: District Superintendent of Land Records, Palghar, Government of Maharashtra; Maharashtra Department of Land Records
registryEvidence.basis: The official Palghar district land-record page identifies the district land-record office and lists Bhu-Naksha/e-map and land-record services. The official contact page places the Palghar office on Palghar-Boisar Road. This establishes a local district custodian, but not an anonymously verified Boisar parcel response.

Its Marathi table reports district map digitization and uploaded-map counts by taluka, but does not expose parcel geometry in the page response.
